overview_description.description: Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Dubai / Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, the company develops a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution that integrates data from multiple hospitality systems—such as property management systems (PMS), point-of-sale systems (POS), ERP, and other internal and external data sources—into a unified platform. This allows hotel owners, operators, investors, and asset managers to gain real-time insights into their business performance.

product.name: Intelligent Total Profitable Revenue Tool (iTopiT)
product.description: A tool providing integrated, granular analysis of profitability across hospitality revenue streams to control net total revenue.

product.description: A tool that provides real-time monitoring and control of profitability flow-through across diverse hospitality revenue streams.
